This is a close race, and not every voter knows who James Talarico really is yet.

So let’s be clear: James Talarico is an extreme candidate.

He says God is non-binary. He says there are six genders. He wants a state income tax. And he told left-wing activists his objective is to dismantle capitalism.

Those views may work in California. They’re not Texas.

President Trump is bringing the party together to focus on the issues and the stakes in this election.

Midterms are tough for the party in power. The Left is energized. Republicans control the White House and Congress, and too many conservatives are complacent.

But in the last two years, President Trump and a Republican Congress have delivered more conservative victories than any time in our lifetimes.

Now we have to defend them.

Low taxes. Less regulation. More jobs. A secure border. Safer
